title: Delhi High Court restrains Sanjay Dutt-backed company from using 'Godfather' mark to sell whisky
description: The Delhi High Court on Monday restrained Sanjay Dutt-backed company Cartel Bros from using the "Godfather" trademark for their whisky. Justice Tushar Rao Gedela allowed the interim injunction plea filed by Devans Modern Breweries.“Accordingly, the defendants [Cartel Bros], their successors, assigns, partners, directors, and all others acting for and on its behalf are restrained from manufacturing, bottling, marketing, selling, offering for sale, advertising, exporting, using the mark “GODF
